title: Prompt bar
description: An AI prompt box that types a prompt with a blinking caret, the pointer clicks send, and a shimmering 'Generating…' pill appears. For AI product promos and app demos.

prompt.default: Make me a minimal portable music player

placeholder.description: Grey text in the empty box before typing starts.

status.description: The pill shown after sending (empty: no pill).

brand.description: Small label above the box, e.g. the product name (empty: none).

cursor.description: Show a pointer that clicks the send button.

position.description: Where the box sits in the frame.
